_comment: Human-curated causal layer. Every edge needs rationale+source. Metric numbers are NOT stored here (parsed from files by build.py); ACCEPTED_BECAUSE edges cite the metric id that build.py creates. JSON format = YAML-compatible subset, stdlib-only parsing.

hypotheses.label: Blind uncentered invariance (L_inv all tokens) improves OOD transfer
Asymmetric inv (inv_head MLP, BYOL-style) fixes rank collapse AND OOD
Per-probe L2 waveform-invariant tokenizer (dropping spectral mag) fixes OOD
Unsupervised calibration readout (P1u_s2 + Otsu) is the deployable default on Hall
Nonlinear probe (MLP) on calibrated features unlocks transfer
Selective inv on sound-metal tokens only (oracle mask Stage 0) preserves class signal
Energy-adaptive tokenizer front-end improves Chirp/TMR OOD (trades off Rivet_v2/Sizing contrast)
Continuous 2D coordinate pos_mlp (Option A) + non-enclosing contiguous wedge masking + scan-centered L_inv fixes FM7/FM8/FM11
Patch-level shared energy normalization (patch_energy_norm, dim=(-2,-1)) preserves spatial contrast and restores Rivet_v2/Sizing without losing Chirp/TMR
Decoupled Median-Patch Energy Normalization (median_patch_energy on exp56 base: per-probe unit-variance x_norm + 25-probe median std for v_pp/energy_t/mag) fixes FM11 without FM13
Asymmetric Scan-Centered Invariance (scan_centered_inv + inv_predictor + predictor_scattering_only + FP32 VICReg on exp56 base) closes both FM8 and FM6

Full-Context Asymmetric Per-Scan-Centered Invariance (predictor_scattering_only=False + per-scan group centering in scan_centered_inv + inv_predictor=True on exp56 base) cures FM15 while preserving H11's FM6/FM8 fix and Sizing/CKA gains

Clean tokenizer + subspace norm (clean_phasor_token: peak-polarity alignment, 5 diffusion-energy quantiles, root-saliency complex phasors without +-pi branch cut; subspace_norm: separate LayerNorm for z_c and bias-free LayerNorm for z_s; repaired zc_cond grounding) removes FM16/FM17 on exp60 base

failures.label: Blind-inv washout: aligning defect-coupled tokens across conditions destroys class signal (over-invariance)
Train-scan telemetry optimism: pre-fix telemetry measured TRAIN scans, not the 4 canonical val files
Probe sign/direction rotates per condition: supervised directions that work on Hall fail on TMR
P2 is a polarity mirror (1-P0 on hard files), not a learned TMR defect direction
Mahalanobis readout is ~0.667 across same-tokenizer dual_domain runs (021809/135025/exp51/exp54), rises to 0.695 on exp53 and 0.7192 on exp56
L_inv amplitude-shrinkage hijack: direct symmetric L_inv (inv_predictor=False) when FM8 DC offset is blocked collapses rank (23.1D->1.2D in exp57a/b, 10->1.2D in exp49_161630)

Train-inference spatial token & pos_embed mismatch: ContextEncoder trained only on 16 outer probes (9..24) while pos_embed[0:9] received zero grad in Encoder (trained only in Predictor), yet extract_features feeds all 25 probes to ContextEncoder

LayerNorm DC-bias needle bypass of L_inv: when offset_weight=0 and scan_centered_inv=False (021809, exp52, exp53, exp56), context_encoder.norm.bias[32:] inflates (max 5.3-13.3) so raw cos=0.985-0.995 while scan-centered cos is only 0.034-0.111

Small-group sound-metal noise amplification: scan_id=pair_idx (112 pairs -> 2.28 samples/group in batch 256) with pool_var_weight=0.5 + offset_weight=0.005 forces patch-mean variance on uncorrelated sound noise, driving pred_loss 1.07->1.74 before L_inv starts at ep 15

Pretraining val leakage & metric blindness: PairedPECTDataset loads all 16 Base Domain scans (12 train + 4 val = 112 pairs); per-scan Mahalanobis val_auc is blind to cross-condition rotation; global batch R_eff (38.9D) hides within-scan z_s rank (2.57D in exp53 vs 7.21D in exp56)

Per-probe (dim=-1) temporal normalization erases within-patch spatial amplitude contrast ||x_center||/||x_ring||, degrading Rivet_v2 (0.592->0.486) and Sizing R2 (+0.238->-0.101) in exp53 and collapsing sizing (-5.07) in exp52

Rank-dependent ZCA whitening mismatch & carrier shortcut: on low within-scan rank (2.57D in exp53) full 64x64 ZCA needs s2=1e-2 shrinkage, whereas on high within-scan rank (7.21D in exp56) s2=1e-2 over-damps 2nd-7th scattering axes (P1u_s5=0.6114 > P1u=0.5893 >> P1u_s2=0.5425)

Outer-ring (r3=7px) boundary variance coupling in patch_energy_norm: shared 25-probe std divides center probe 0 by outer-ring edge/lift-off steps, doubling sound variance (0.011->0.021) and centroid drift (7.57->19.61) and hurting linear probe on Chirp/Gaussian (0.5301 vs MLP_p1 0.5834)

Local patch-median AGC washout of macroscopic defect interiors: C-scans are already global_peak normalized per file; dividing v_pp/energy_t/mag by per-patch 25-probe median std (std_med) acts as a local AGC filter (r2=4px) that forces energy_t ~ log(2) inside wide defects and removes (mean_t)^2 DC flux, dropping Test LP 0.5579->0.4973 and Val Sizing R2 0.5599->0.2921 in exp59a

Unconditioned scattering-only target bottleneck & batch-mean centering residual: zeroing H_ctx_c in predictor (predictor_scattering_only=True) while predicting cross-condition targets without condition_token forces target encoder z_s into a low-rank (2.64D vs 7.00D) intersection across waveforms, hurting Chirp LP (0.5146->0.4241) in exp59b

Stopband phase-wrap noise in tokenizer: raw phase=angle(X_k)/pi on harmonics with ~0 energy (Hall_Pot Gaussian k>=9: saliency<0.01%, phase_std 0.14-0.58; Square k>=11: phase_std up to 0.99) injects +-pi branch-cut noise that dominates freq_proj input; zeroing the raw-phase columns of exp60 freq_proj flips z1-z2 defect-pixel cosine on Hall_Air Gaussian from -0.16 to +0.35. TMR polarity (x->-x) is an additional uncancelled sign flip for time_proj

Dead condition path + shared LayerNorm: in every disentangled run exp47-exp60 predictor is called with condition_token=None and zc_cond target is c_b.detach(), so cond_proj receives no gradient (measured grad=None on exp60); shared LayerNorm(64) over [z_c,z_s] lets z_c dominate (preLN RMS 7-12 vs 4-6) and z_s post-LN std falls to 0.003-0.012 on Chirp vs 0.10 on Gaussian/Square

invariants.label: Hardware offsets via unsupervised spatial self-calibration; no cross-sensor penalties (GEMINI.md s4)
Pure SSL: no waveform/sensor metadata injection (GEMINI.md s3)
Check-before-proposing: consult registry/graph before new directions (GEMINI.md s2)
Causal chain required: Code/Math -> Optimization -> Latent geometry -> Downstream (GEMINI.md s5)
Zero metric recycling: claims about a checkpoint need that checkpoint's own measurements (GEMINI.md s5)

Otsu threshold replacing fixed 0.5 for IoU (0.0278 IoU / 0.0528 F1 on exp56)
P3 supervised (best on exp51 only, not transferable)
Official MLP probe on raw features (0.5739 on exp56, 0.5732 on exp53)
Outlier-trimmed (keep_q=0.75 MAD energy) unsupervised bg whitening + s2 (improves high-defect Rivet_v2/Square, but trims high-drift sound bg on Chirp/TMR)
Mahalanobis distance readout (0.7192 Test AUC on exp56, 0.6948 on exp53, 0.6679 on 021809)

exp51_asyminv_20261015_013636.verdict: Best ep 94/100. Confounded by FM9 (pool_var=0.5 + offset=0.005 drove pred_loss 1.07->1.72 by ep 15 before L_inv). Test LP 0.4729; fixing FM7 inference path (16-ctx+Pred0) jumps Corrosion z1 TMR AUC 0.2925->0.5809.

exp52_waveforminv_tokenizer_20261015_130.verdict: Best ep 19/34. Per-probe L2 norm + dropping spectral mag (FM11) collapsed sizing R2 (-5.07 test, -11.56 val) and OOD LP (0.4747), while LN_bias[32:] bypassed L_inv (FM8).

exp53_energyadaptive_tokenizer_20261015_.verdict: Best ep 90/100. Clean 1-var ablation vs 021809 (both have offset_weight=0, pool_var_weight=0; LN_bias_s max=5.298 via FM8; within-scan R_eff=2.57D). Test LP 0.5630, P1u_s2 0.5669, P1u_trim_s2 0.5610, MLPraw 0.5732, Maha 0.6948. Boosts Only-Chirp (0.562->0.640) and Only-TMR (0.529->0.555, Maha 0.592->0.679), but per-probe dim=-1 norm (FM11) regresses Only-Rivet_v2 (0.592->0.486) and Val Sizing R2 (+0.238->-0.101).

exp54_selective_oracle_20261015_223926.verdict: Best ep 74/89. Confounded by FM9: pred_loss rose 1.068->1.733 in ep 1..15 while L_inv=0 due to pool_var=0.5 + offset=0.005. Against matched baseline exp51, H6 mask IMPROVED Test LP (0.4729->0.4929), Val AP (0.0543->0.1641, 3x), Only-Chirp (0.433->0.485), Only-TMR (0.420->0.448), and achieved highest Test auc_oracle (0.7929).

exp55_energyadaptive_clean_20261016_1415.verdict: DEAD, do not relaunch: premise false (exp53 vs 021809 was already clean 1-var) + live FM9 (pred 1.09->1.45 ep1-11 pre-inv, rank 13.8D->3.5D, R_eff floor FAIL, no best ever saved). Process ended ep16.

exp56_contpos_wedgemask_20261016_171527.verdict: Dead early attempt (~15 ep, ended 18:41); superseded by the completed run exp56_contpos_wedgemask_20261016_185414.

exp56_contpos_wedgemask_20261016_185414.verdict: H8 structural arm (cont-pos + wedge masking on exp53 base, best ep 52/67): expands within-scan R_eff 2.81x (2.57D->7.21D, Top1_EV 76.5%->51.6%, defect norm 0.666->1.927, hyperplane cos +0.003->+0.148). Achieves NEW PROJECT BESTS on Test P1u (0.5893 vs exp53 P1u_s2 0.5669), Test P1u_s5 (0.6114), Test P1u_maha (0.7094), Test Maha (0.7192, AP 0.0645, CNR 0.912), Test LP_AP (0.0822, +117%), Test auc_oracle (0.6659), Otsu F1 (0.0528), Hall_Air LP (0.6466), Hall_Pot LP (0.6776), Only-Chirp (0.661/0.812), Only-Rivet_v2 (0.569/0.737), Only-z2 (0.902/0.881), Val LP (0.9812, AP 0.5782) & Val Sizing R2 (+0.5599, MAE 1.264mm). Overall raw LP is 0.5579 (<0.585 bar) and P1u_s2 is 0.5425 because: (1) FM8 still active (LN_bias_s max=10.12) and sharper Hall spatial gradients invert TMR raw LP polarity to 0.4114 (while TMR auc_oracle=0.6387 and TMR P1u=0.5117); (2) s2=1e-2 over-damps 7.21D rank whereas unshrunk P1u (1e-4) reaches 0.5893 and P1u_s5 reaches 0.6114.

exp57a_centered_scat_20261016_154637.verdict: H8 loss arm (scan_centered_inv + predictor_scattering_only, cov=0.2, inv=0.2, best ep 13/24): scan_centered_inv completely eliminates FM8 needle (LN_bias_s mean 1.540->0.024, max 0.055; CentroidDrift 19.41->6.94) and lifts Square LP to 0.6801 / Only-Rivet_v2 LP to 0.627 / TMR LP to 0.5214. However, blocking FM8 without inv_predictor=True directly re-arms FM6: as L_inv ramps after ep 12, global R_eff collapses 23.12D (ep13)->11.1D (ep14)->3.49D (ep16)->1.27D (ep21) and cov_loss overflows FP16 to nan at ep 22. Best ckpt at ep 13 is under-trained (pred_loss=0.6145, Test LP 0.5621, Maha 0.6018).

exp57b_centered_scat_oracle_20261016_154.verdict: H6 clean 1-var retest ([B,25] oracle sound mask on top of exp57a, best ep 13/23): since 97.4% of tokens are sound metal (inv_sound_frac=0.9739), symmetric direct L_inv on sound tokens still collapses global R_eff from 26.80D (ep13) to 1.26D (ep20) with FP16 nan at ep 21. Test LP drops 0.5621->0.5217 (-0.0404), Chirp 0.5331->0.4575. H6 is definitively REJECTED.

exp58a_patch_energy_norm_20261016_232220.verdict: H9 1-var test (patch_energy_norm=True vs exp53, ep 100/100, global rank 43.65D): confirms FM11 mechanism on Sizing & Rivet_v2 — Val Sizing R2 jumps -0.1013->+0.3053 (MAE 1.575mm, PASS >0.20 bar), Test Sizing R2 improves -0.4000->-0.2527, Only-Rivet_v2 LP jumps 0.486->0.610 (PASS >=0.58 bar), Square LP jumps 0.5218->0.6197, and nonlinear MLP_p1 reaches 0.5834. However, overall Linear Probe regresses 0.5630->0.5301 (Chirp 0.5013, Gaussian 0.4950) due to FM13: outer-ring (r3=7px) edge/lift-off variance inflates shared patch std and scales down center probe 0, doubling sound variance (0.011->0.021) and centroid drift (7.57->19.61).

exp59a_contpos_median_energy_20261017_03.verdict: H10 1-var test (median_patch_energy=True on exp56 base, best ep 42/57, global R_eff 40.5D, within-scan R_eff 6.71D): avoids FM13 boundary variance inflation (sigma_sound^2=0.0571 vs 0.0559 in exp56) and improves Square P1u (0.5911->0.6122) & Square P1u_s2 (0.5694->0.5958), with Test Maha=0.7112 and P1u_maha=0.6964 (AP 0.0924). However, overall Test LP drops 0.5579->0.4973, P1u drops 0.5893->0.5470, P1u_s5 drops 0.6114->0.5346, Rivet_v2 LP drops 0.5662->0.4675, and Val Sizing R2 drops 0.5599->0.2921 due to FM14: since C-scans are already global_peak normalized per file, dividing v_pp/energy_t/mag by per-patch 25-probe median std (std_med) acts as a local AGC filter (r2=4px) that washes out macroscopic defect interiors (energy_t ~ log(2)) and strips (mean_t)^2 DC flux.

exp59b_contpos_asyminv_centered_20261017.verdict: H11 test (scan_centered_inv + inv_predictor + predictor_scattering_only + FP32 VICReg on exp56 base, best ep 88/100; note: 2 concurrent Colab processes ran ep 39-76): completely cures FM6 rank collapse & FP16 NaN (trains 100 ep, global R_eff 16.9D, val_auc 0.9280, val_snr 11.20) and cures FM8 LN-bias needle (LN_bias_s max 10.12->0.260, mean 0.0695; CentroidDrift 19.47->7.75; Cross-Sensor CKA 0.541->0.645, Cross-Waveform CKA 0.497->0.645; Hyperplane cos +0.120->+0.147). Achieves NEW PROJECT BEST Val Sizing R2 (+0.7755, MAE 0.901mm) & Train Sizing R2 (+0.7841, MAE 0.833mm), Val P1u_s2 (0.9694, AP 0.5248), Test Hall_Pot P1u (0.6948 vs 0.6675) & Hall_Pot Maha (0.7927 vs 0.7882), Test Rivet_v2 P1u (0.5519 vs 0.5008) & P1u_s2 (0.5467 vs 0.5007), and Test P1u_s5=0.5689 / Maha=0.7106 / P1u_maha=0.6888. However, predictor_scattering_only=True compresses within-scan R_eff from 7.00D to 2.64D (FM15), hurting Chirp LP (0.5146->0.4241) and overall Test LP (0.5579->0.4864).

exp60_contpos_asyminv_fullctx_20261017_1.verdict: H12 test (predictor_scattering_only=False + per-scan group centering in scan_centered_inv + inv_predictor=True on exp56 base, best ep 83/98): PASSES all H8/H12 bars (LP>=0.585, P1u_s2>=0.590). Sets NEW PROJECT BESTS on Test LP_raw (0.6082 vs 0.5630 in exp53, +0.0452; beats exp59b 0.4864 by +0.1218), Test P1u_s2 (0.6018 vs 0.5669 in exp53, +0.0349), Test P1u_trim_s2 (0.6126 vs 0.5610, +0.0516), Test P1u (0.6018 vs 0.5893 in exp56), Test IoU_05 (0.0274) & IoU_otsu/F1_otsu (0.0306/0.0580), Hall_Air LP/P1u_s2 (0.7015/0.7194) & Maha (0.7323), TMR LP (0.5281 vs 0.4114 in exp56), Chirp LP/P1u/P1u_s5 (0.6011/0.6313/0.6314 vs 0.4241 in exp59b), Square LP/P1u_s2 (0.6564/0.6875), Rivet_v1 LP (0.6770), Rivet_v2 P1u/P1u_s2 (0.5690/0.5730), Val Maha (0.9457, peak 0.9498 at ep 60, CNR 2.903, Otsu F1 0.2061), and Val Sizing R2 (+0.6778, MAE 1.040mm). Cures FM8 (LN_bias_s max=0.2691) and achieves lowest CentroidDrift (4.6517) & highest Cross-Waveform CKA/RSA (0.6621/0.6156). Caveat (FM16): since inv_cosine=True is scale-invariant and predictor L1 loss scales with ||H_tgt_s||, EMA target amplitude shrinks 10x after ep 33 (val_sound_var 0.181->0.0042, pred_loss 0.72->0.072), keeping within-scan R_eff at 2.78D.

Replaces fixed 0.5 threshold for IoU eval (0.0306 IoU / 0.0580 F1 on exp60 Test, 0.1150 IoU / 0.2061 F1 on exp60 Val).

Structural arm of H8 (cont-pos + wedge masking, offset=0/pool=0): expands within-scan R_eff 2.57D->7.21D, sets new project bests on P1u (0.5893), P1u_s5 (0.6114), P1u_maha (0.7094), Maha (0.7192), LP_AP (0.0822), Hall_Air (0.6466), Hall_Pot (0.6776), Only-Chirp (0.661), Only-z2 (0.902), Val Sizing R2 (+0.5599).

Loss arm of H8 (scan_centered_inv + predictor_scattering_only without inv_predictor): closes FM8 (LN_bias_s=0.024, CentroidDrift=6.94, Square LP=0.6801) but direct symmetric L_inv collapses global rank 23.1D->1.27D (FM6) and overflows FP16 cov_loss to nan at ep 22.
Clean unconfounded 1-var retest of H6 ([B,25] oracle masks vs exp57a): still collapses global rank 26.8D->1.26D at ep 20 and lowers Test LP 0.5621->0.5217 (-0.0404).

Single-var patch_energy_norm vs exp53: restores Val Sizing R2 (-0.101->+0.305) and Only-Rivet_v2 (0.486->0.610) and reaches MLP_p1=0.5834, but regresses raw LP to 0.5301 via FM13 outer-ring variance coupling.

1-var test of median_patch_energy on exp56 base (best ep 42/57): keeps within-scan R_eff=6.71D and boosts Square P1u (0.5911->0.6122), but per-patch std_med AGC washout (FM14) lowers Test LP 0.5579->0.4973, P1u 0.5893->0.5470, and Val Sizing R2 0.5599->0.2921.

Asymmetric scan_centered_inv + predictor_scattering_only + FP32 VICReg on exp56 base (best ep 88/100): cures FM6 & FM8 (LN_bias_s max 10.12->0.26, CentroidDrift 19.47->7.75, CKA 0.645, Val Sizing R2 +0.7755, Val P1u_s2 0.9694, Hall_Pot P1u 0.6948, Rivet_v2 P1u 0.5519), while predictor_scattering_only compresses within-scan R_eff to 2.64D (FM15) and lowers Chirp LP to 0.4241.

Full-context predictor (predictor_scattering_only=False) + per-scan group centering in scan_centered_inv + inv_predictor=True on exp56 base (best ep 83/98): jumps Test LP 0.4864->0.6082 (+0.1218, new project best), Test P1u_s2 0.5236->0.6018 (+0.0782, new project best), Test P1u_trim_s2 0.4900->0.6126 (+0.1226, new project best), Test P1u 0.5669->0.6018, Chirp LP 0.4241->0.6011 (+0.1770), TMR LP 0.3986->0.5281 (+0.1295), Hall_Air LP 0.4988->0.7015 (+0.2027), Val Maha 0.9457 (peak 0.9498), Val Sizing R2 +0.6778, CentroidDrift 7.75->4.65, Cross-Waveform CKA 0.6621.

Structural arm (exp56 cont-pos + wedge mask) expanded within-scan R_eff 2.57D->7.21D, defect norm 0.666->1.927, and achieved new bests on Test P1u (0.5893), Test P1u_s5 (0.6114), Test P1u_maha (0.7094), Test Maha (0.7192), Hall LP (0.65-0.68), and Val Sizing R2 (+0.5599).

Loss arm (exp57a scan_centered_inv without inv_predictor) forked FM8 into FM6: with the LN-bias needle blocked (0.024), direct symmetric L_inv collapsed rank 23.1D->1.27D and triggered FP16 cov_loss=nan at ep 22.
Clean retest (exp57b vs exp57a) confirms: 97.4% of tokens are sound metal, so selective sound-token invariance still triggers FM6 rank collapse and lowers Test LP by -0.0404.

While patch_energy_norm fixes FM11 on Sizing R2 (+0.3053) and Only-Rivet_v2 (0.610), outer-ring r3=7px boundary steps inflate std_patch and couple into center probe 0 (FM13), lowering Chirp/Gaussian linear probe to 0.501/0.495.

Dividing v_pp/energy_t/mag by per-patch 25-probe median std on global_peak-normalized C-scans acts as a local AGC filter (r2=4px), washing out macroscopic defect interiors (energy_t ~ log(2)) and regressing Test LP (0.5579->0.4973) and Val Sizing R2 (0.5599->0.2921).

Pairing scan_centered_inv with inv_predictor=True and FP32 VICReg completely eliminates FM6 rank collapse & FP16 NaN (trains 100 ep at 16.9D global rank, val_auc 0.9280) and closes FM8 (LN_bias_s max 10.12->0.26, CentroidDrift 19.47->7.75, Cross-Sensor/Waveform CKA 0.645, Val Sizing R2 +0.7755).
predictor_scattering_only=True with unconditioned predictor compresses within-scan R_eff from 7.00D to 2.64D (Top-1 EV 75.2%), hurting Chirp LP (0.5146->0.4241) and overall Test LP (0.5579->0.4864).

Restoring H_ctx_c to predictor (predictor_scattering_only=False) + per-scan group centering in scan_centered_inv rescues Chirp LP (0.4241->0.6011, P1u 0.6313), TMR LP (0.3986->0.5281), Hall_Air LP (0.4988->0.7015), and sets new project bests on Test LP (0.6082), Test P1u_s2 (0.6018), Test P1u_trim_s2 (0.6126), Test P1u (0.6018), Test Otsu F1 (0.0580), and Val Maha (0.9457), while preserving FM8 closure (LN_bias_s max=0.2691, CentroidDrift=4.6517) and Val Sizing R2 (+0.6778).

On 7.21D exp56, lowering ZCA shrinkage to eps=1e-5 with keep_q=0.85 trimming preserves 2nd-8th scattering eigenvalues in [1e-5, 1e-3], lifting 65-file Test AUC from 0.5425 (s2) / 0.5893 (1e-4) to 0.6114 (AP 0.0899, Hall_Air 0.6712, Hall_Pot 0.6692, TMR 0.5285, Corrosion 0.6404, Rivet_v1 0.7274).

Combining directional |P1u - med| z-score with isotropic Mahalanobis z-score reaches 0.7094 Test AUC / 0.0936 AP across 65 Test files on exp56 (Hall_Air 0.7268, Hall_Pot 0.7775, TMR 0.6492), 0.6982 on exp60, 0.6964 on exp59a, and 0.6888 on exp59b.

Keeps x_norm strictly per-probe unit-variance so outer-ring r3 boundary steps do not inflate sound variance (sigma_sound^2=0.0571 vs 0.0559 in exp56), though local std_med on amplitude anchors introduces FM14.
